last.minutes: We maintain our disciplined spot allocations in BTC, SOL, and SUI to preserve capital and avoid unnecessary transaction and tax drag during this neutral market consolidation. Keeping the futures book flat protects against funding fee spikes and volatile leverage risks while greed sentiment remains elevated but range-bound. This patient approach prevents over-trading and keeps dry powder ready for cleaner directional trends.

lessons.text: Holding core spot positions with active stop losses during market consolidation minimizes transaction fees and non-deductible tax drag while preserving capital for clearer market trends.
